frankxai-awesome-hermes-agent-skills-cod.description: Use when orchestrating multiple coding agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Grok CLI, Antigravity). Discovery, comparison, structured prompting, and multi-agent handoff patterns. Portable free pack — no host-specific secrets.
frankxai-awesome-hermes-agent-skills-cod.author: Frank Riemer / GenCreator

frankxai-awesome-hermes-agent-skills-ecc.description: Use when a Hermes session is about to edit a linter config or a TypeScript file. Warns on console.log and blocks weakening an existing formatter config. Does not install the ECC marketplace.
frankxai-awesome-hermes-agent-skills-ecc.author: Frank Riemer

frankxai-awesome-hermes-agent-skills-tod.description: Use when starting any complex task (3+ steps) or before declaring work complete. Enforces todo/task state to match reality — merge updates + read verification. Prevents false completion.
frankxai-awesome-hermes-agent-skills-tod.author: Frank Riemer / GenCreator
